project.title: Bacterial community in atmospheric environment
project.description: We have analyzed the temporal dynamics of the bacterial community in 315 aerosol samples over a three-year period, from April 10th, 2019, to May 14th, 2022.
project.center_name: Environmental Microbiology  Microbiology, Pusan National University
